title: A Shared Verification-Overhead Note for Ecosystem-Service Bundles

claim_inventory.claim: Two separate verification processes pay the fixed setup burden twice, while one shared process pays it once.
The no-interaction saving from sharing an identical fixed setup burden is exactly F.
With interaction overhead h, the saving is F-h and sharing is strictly cheaper when h<F.
Supplied marginal lower bounds propagate to a bundled lower bound.
Nonnegative net service is equivalent to gross service covering the bundled verification burden.
F=2, v1=3, v2=5 gives separate cost 12, bundled cost 10, and saving 2.
The exact-rational verification output is green and byte-captured.
Common burden units, identical fixed setup, unchanged marginal work, and complete interaction accounting are supplied assumptions.
Real ecosystem-service additivity, valid credit stacking, measured physical energy savings, registry integrity, adoption, delivery, or revenue is established.

high_risk_claims.support: Restricted to two audits with the same fixed setup burden and unchanged marginal burdens, before interaction overhead.
Strictly conditional on modeled interaction overhead h being less than the duplicated fixed burden F.
Only propagates a supplied epsilon; k_B T ln 2 interpretation is conditional on specified logically irreversible physical operations.
Title-level application context only; no ecological additivity, synergy, fungibility, or stacking conclusion.
